notes: Over-refusal cause, 1 item(s) — remote-003: the turn refused with `no policy evidence was retrieved` while `check_policy_compliance` had already returned a decided verdict whose citations resolve to real chunks of the committed index. G1's evidence gate weighs the retrieved chunks only, so the engine's own evidence — which the synthesis prompt does carry — cannot clear it. Counting compliance-resolved chunks as citable evidence for G1 is a candidate P11/P12 fix.

items.answer: Full-time employees with three or more years of service accrue 1.50 days of PTO per month.

Hybrid employees assigned to a hub office must work on site at least 3 days each week. The specific days are set by the team to ensure onsite days overlap and office time is collaborative; most teams anchor on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.

The requirement is measured as a rolling four-week average in MosaicOne rather than week by week, so a single unusual week is never a compliance problem. Weeks containing a company holiday, approved PTO or approved travel reduce the requirement proportionally.

Next steps:
- Confirm your team's specific onsite days with your manager
- Review your rolling four-week average in MosaicOne to verify compliance

New hires become eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage 90 days after their hire date. Coverage begins on the day the waiting period ends, not on the first of the following month.

The 401(k) plan has no waiting period; employees may begin contributing from their first payroll run.

Next steps:
- Confirm your hire date to calculate your coverage start date
- Enroll in benefits during week one so elections are in place when eligibility arrives

Mosaic Robotics will never ask an employee for their password, and no genuine internal request will ever ask for a payroll change, a payment redirection or a bulk personal-data extract over email alone. Requests of that shape are verified by a second channel before anyone acts on them, every time, without exception, regardless of who appears to have sent them.

Report suspected phishing by forwarding the message to phishing@mosaicrobotics.example. The security team answers every report, including the ones that turn out to be legitimate mail, and publishes a short monthly summary of what was seen.

Recommendation — not company policy: Do not reply to the message and do not act on the request. Delete it after reporting.

Next steps:
- Forward the suspicious email to phishing@mosaicrobotics.example
- Delete the message

Each employee may claim up to USD 750 per plan year for home office furniture and accessories. The allowance is intended for items that make a home workspace work, such as a desk, chair, lamp, footrest, adjustable monitor arm, acoustic treatment, or small filing cabinet.

The allowance resets on 1 January and does not carry over. It is available to hybrid and fully remote employees; onsite employees may claim against it only where their manager has agreed a regular remote pattern in MosaicOne.

Laptops, monitors, docks, keyboards, mice, headsets and webcams are not claimed against this allowance; they are issued as company assets under the Equipment & Asset Policy.

Next steps:
- Review the full Home Office and Equipment Stipends section in the Expenses & Reimbursement Policy for eligible items and submission procedures
- Confirm your employment status (hybrid, fully remote, or onsite with manager approval) in MosaicOne to verify eligibility

Mosaic Robotics provides 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave to every eligible new parent. The 16 weeks are the same whether the employee gave birth, did not give birth, adopted, or became a parent through surrogacy or foster placement leading to adoption.

Next steps:
- Confirm your eligibility (6 months of continuous service required)
- Coordinate timing with your manager and People Operations if you plan to split the leave into multiple blocks

The standard lodging cap is USD 250 per night before taxes and fees. The cap covers the room rate only; local occupancy taxes, resort fees and mandatory service charges are reimbursable above it.

The cap rises to USD 350 per night in Boston, New York, San Francisco, London, Zurich and Tokyo, and for any city during a period when a conference the company is attending has inflated local rates.

Where the cap cannot be met — a remote field site with one hotel, a sold-out market — the traveller books the most reasonable available option and notes the reason. No pre-approval is needed; the note is enough.

Next steps:
- Contact MosaicOne Travel if you need clarification on whether your destination qualifies for the higher cap or if you encounter a market where the standard cap cannot be met.

International remote work of more than 30 consecutive days requires approval from the employee's director and from Tax & Legal. The notice period is 21 calendar days.

A stay of more than 30 consecutive days in another country requires a Tax & Legal review before travel begins. The review determines whether shadow payroll must be opened, whether a certificate of coverage is needed for social security, and whether the employee's planned activities create permanent-establishment exposure.

An employee working abroad remains on their home payroll unless Tax & Legal open a shadow payroll. Shadow payroll reports the same earnings to a second authority so that withholding can be remitted where it is owed.

Recommendation — not company policy: File the Tax & Legal review request in MosaicOne at least 21 calendar days before departure, naming the destination, exact dates, workspace address, and a description of the work to be performed while abroad.

Next steps:
- Obtain direct manager approval
- Obtain director approval
- Submit Tax & Legal review request at least 21 days before departure
- Await Tax & Legal determination on shadow payroll and certificate of coverage

Flights must be booked at least 14 calendar days before departure whenever the itinerary is known.

The standard lodging cap is USD 250 per night before taxes and fees.

An itemised receipt is required for every expense of USD 25 or more.

Expense reports USD 2,501 to USD 10,000 require director approval and a finance business partner as second approver.

Next steps:
- Book the conference trip through MosaicOne Travel at least 14 days before departure
- Obtain manager approval before booking, then director approval for the USD 3,000 spend
- Retain itemised receipts for all expenses of USD 25 or more
- Submit the expense report with both director and finance business partner approval

Security and acceptable-use training must be completed within 14 calendar days of the start date.

All four required trainings (security and acceptable use, data protection and privacy, anti-harassment and respectful workplace, and anti-bribery and corruption) must be completed within 30 calendar days of the start date.

Benefits enrolment opens in week one, and the 90-day waiting period ends when the employee's benefits eligibility date arrives at day 90. Enrolling early means elections are in place when eligibility arrives.

Standard equipment (laptop, power adapter, headset, and for remote hires the monitor, keyboard, mouse and dock) is shipped to arrive at least 5 business days before the start date.

For engineering roles, the standard laptop configuration for 2026 is a 14-inch developer laptop with 32 GB of memory.

Recommendation — not company policy: Complete benefits elections during week one even though coverage does not begin until day 90, so elections are in place when eligibility arrives.

Next steps:
- Confirm security training completion by day 14
- Ensure all four required trainings are finished by day 30
- Complete benefits elections in week one
- Verify equipment arrival at least 5 business days before start date

Severity 1 cases receive a response within 4 business hours. Response means a named human being contacting the person who raised the case, acknowledging what was raised, naming who owns it and describing what happens next.

Target resolution times for Severity 1 cases are as fast as the facts allow. Where a case will run past its target, the person who raised it is told in writing why and when to expect the next update. Updates continue at least every 10 business days until the case closes.

Escalation: The published policy does not specify a separate investigation timeline or investigation completion deadline for Severity 1 cases. Contact People Operations for details on investigation procedures and expected duration.

Next steps:
- Contact People Operations if you need clarification on investigation timelines for your specific case
- Reference your case number when following up on progress

PTO requests must be submitted at least 5 business days in advance. A request of six or more consecutive business days requires 15 business days of advance notice. Notice is counted in business days between the day the request is submitted in MosaicOne and the first day of the requested absence, excluding both the submission day and any company holiday on the employee's office calendar.

PTO requests of any length are approved by the employee's direct manager. Longer requests (more than 15 consecutive business days) and requests overlapping a blackout period additionally require director approval.

Recommendation — not company policy: As of 2026-09-01, your PTO balance is 13.5 remaining days. You accrue 1.5 days per month, with your next accrual on 2026-10-01. Note that blackout dates are 2026-12-22 and 2026-12-23, which will require director approval if your PTO request overlaps them.

Next steps:
- Submit your PTO request in MosaicOne with the appropriate advance notice based on request length
- Coordinate with your direct manager for approval
- If requesting more than 15 consecutive business days or overlapping blackout dates, ensure director approval is obtained

PTO requests must be submitted at least 5 business days in advance. Notice is counted in business days between the day the request is submitted in MosaicOne and the first day of the requested absence, excluding both the submission day and any company holiday on the employee's office calendar.

Every PTO request requires written approval from the employee's direct manager in MosaicOne. Verbal agreement, a message in chat and an email thread are all insufficient on their own: the approval must be recorded against the request so the audit trail is complete.

PTO requests of any length are approved by the employee's direct manager.

Recommendation — not company policy: You have 13.5 PTO days remaining as of 2026-09-01. Your three-day request is covered by your balance. Submit your request in MosaicOne at least 5 business days before Tuesday 15 September (by Tuesday 8 September at the latest) to allow your manager time to approve it in writing.

Next steps:
- Calculate your submission deadline: 5 business days before 15 September 2026 is 8 September 2026.
- Submit the PTO request in MosaicOne with the dates 15–17 September 2026.
- Obtain written manager approval in MosaicOne before the first day of your absence.

You meet the tenure requirement: employees must have completed at least 12 months of continuous service to work outside their home country. Your tenure as of 2026-09-01 is 45 months.

Germany is an approved destination for temporary work abroad.

Your proposed stay of 42 consecutive days (3 November to 14 December, inclusive) exceeds the 30-day threshold and therefore requires Tax & Legal review before travel begins, director approval (not just manager approval), and a Tax & Legal review request filed at least 21 calendar days before departure.

No employee may work outside their home country for more than 90 days in a rolling 12-month period. Your 42-day stay falls within this limit.

Work performed outside your home country must use a company-managed, full-disk-encrypted laptop with always-on VPN. Personal devices may not be used for any Mosaic Robotics work outside your home country.

Recommendation — not company policy: Notify IT Security of your destination country at least 5 business days before departure so that conditional-access rules and travel-risk monitoring can be adjusted.

Contact mobility@mosaicrobotics.example if you have questions about the process.
